summary: Tested new features: delete order (cascades payments/receipts/images/reminders), delete client (with order-count protection), and Final Confirmed Cake Design upload on the OrderDetail page. Full backend + frontend e2e coverage. All 7 scenarios from the review request pass. Backend suite: 31/36 pass; the 5 pre-existing failures are unrelated to this iteration (flavors endpoint /api/flavors returns 404 — likely mounted under a different prefix; /api/reports returns 404; status audit title uses different wording).

minor.issue: Returns 404 (pre-existing; route may be mounted under a different prefix like /api/catalog/flavors). Not part of this iteration.
Returns 404 (pre-existing). Not part of this iteration.
Audit entry created but title does not contain the word 'Status' — test assertion needs the exact wording (minor).

action_items: (Optional) Fix pre-existing /api/flavors and /api/reports 404s — not part of the current review scope but affects the regression suite.
critical_code_review_comments: DELETE /api/orders/{id} correctly cascades to payments, receipts, order_images (soft-delete via is_deleted flag), and email_reminders, and writes an audit entry. Good.

DELETE /api/clients/{id} correctly enforces order-count protection with a clear 400 message ('This client has N order(s). Delete those orders first, or archive the client instead.') and cleans up feedback. Good.
Both delete endpoints properly return 404 for unknown ids and are gated by get_current_user.
Frontend confirmation uses window.confirm — acceptable for admin-only internal tool; consider a Radix AlertDialog for consistency with the rest of the UI in a follow-up (non-blocking).

success_rate.backend: 100% for iteration scope (delete/upload/payment) — 31/36 overall including pre-existing failures

seed_data_creation: Test-only clients (UITEST_C_*, UITEST_P_*, TEST_Jane_Doe, TEST_NoEmail, TEST_DelBlocked) and their orders are created and cleaned up by the tests themselves via the new delete endpoints.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_pastry_quin.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/test_pastry_quin.py -n 0` (the pytest.ini enforces xdist -n 2 loadscope, but the `created` fixture is session-scoped and won't share across workers, so use -n 0 for full sequential run). Pre-existing 404s on /api/flavors and /api/reports are unrelated to this iteration.
rca of the issue: N/A — all requested features working as designed.
